title: feat(spec,types,plugin-list,app-shell)!: retire the list view's `options` bag; stored bags fold onto the top-level blocks, and the renderers read the blocks alone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFijSMgUXzsRVhP3BchJpt1)_

Part of #25923

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md regenerated by `pnpm gen:react-blocks`; the `list-view` table drops its `options` prop row. No other `skills/**` file teaches the bag: skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md and skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md already write the top-level blocks only.
ADR-0087: registered list-view-options-bag-folded, ui-list-view-options-bag-folded

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表视图的旧 `options` 配置包退役。规范的视图写入口按名拒收 `options` 并提示改写为顶层 `kanban` / `calendar` 等配置块;已存储的配置包由 ADR-0087 D2 转换在下发前折叠到顶层配置块;objectui 的类型镜像直接引用规范的墓碑，`ListView`、对象页中继、界面页、Studio 预览和检查器都只读写顶层配置块。
- 为什么改:同一个配置块有两种写法，每个渲染器各自实现一遍合并(#12);普查在所有可达元数据里找到 0 行存储的配置包，席位裁定走 A 方案一个 PR 落地(claim amendment 6460225523)。
- 风险与回滚:直接写 `options` 的 PUT 请求、页面 `list-view` 节点或 `ListView` 宿主会被拒收或不再生效;已存储的行由服务端折叠，渲染不变。回滚即还原本 PR;D2 转换只在读取时折叠，不改写存储数据。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`(墓碑)、`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`(`list-view-options-bag-folded`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx`(顶层中继)、`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/list-view-options-bag-6152.test.ts packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.readersRetired-6152.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.storedRowParity-10380.test.tsx`,预期全绿:配置包在每个入口被拒收并给出规范原文，源码普查没有 `schema.options` 读取，存储的配置包折叠后两页渲染一致。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地

## What changes

- `@objectstack/spec`: the flattened list overlay's `options` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone that refuses a bag by name with the move-each-`options.KIND`-to-`KIND` prescription. The D2 conversion `list-view-options-bag-folded` folds a stored or source bag onto the top-level blocks before a row is served (top-level wins per key; for `chart`, whose block replaced the bag whole, the top-level block wins whole). It leaves `options.grid`, a non-object block and a bag on a form view in place with a TODO. The D3 entry `ui-list-view-options-bag-folded` names what the fold cannot decide (a folded block can still miss a required key). The page `list-view` component row shares the tombstone, and `react-blocks.ts` drops the `options` prop row.
- `@object-ui/types`: `ListViewSchema.options` is the spec's tombstone by reference, so the mirror, the tolerant and strict faces and `safeValidateSchema` refuse a bag at `options` with the spec's text, unreworded. `NamedListView.options` is a `?: never` tombstone naming the top-level blocks, moved from held to retired in the `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779` census (22 tombstones, was 21). The dataset-chart filter refusal reads the `chart` block alone. A page node's flat `options` is refused with the bag text rather than pointed at `properties.options`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`: `ListView` reads every kind from its top-level block alone (render branches, capability gate, projection and expand collectors, fetch effect dependencies). The `list-view` registration publishes no `options` input.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: the object page relays each per-kind block at the top level of the list schema, each held by value through `isSameOptionsValue` so an equal rebuild keeps its identity, and forwards no stored bag (`storedLegacyOptions` removed). The interface page sends one `map` block (its derivation with the authored keys laid over) and no bag. `ViewPreview` and the list-view inspector fold nothing; the server does.
- `@object-ui/plugin-view`: the host list schema carries the active view's blocks at the top level instead of under `options`. `@object-ui/plugin-map`: two development warnings name the `map` block.
- `@object-ui/console`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/lint`: test pins only.

## Tests

- Refusal on the authoring face: `list-view-options-bag-6152` pins the mirror IS the spec tombstone, and every door refuses five bag shapes at `options` with the spec's text, beside a CONTROL that the same blocks written top-level parse. The named alias refusals the bag carried are pinned at the top-level block.
- No read left: `ListView.readersRetired-6152` gains a SOURCE census (TypeScript AST over every non-test plugin-list file) that finds no `schema.options` read, with a firing control on `schema.kanban` and a probe of each retired shape. The same scanner finds 39 reads in `ListView.tsx` on `origin/main`. The object page relay census (`ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559`) declares `options` unread and every block relayed; the interface page census (`InterfaceListPage.relayCensus-11572`) writes `map` and not `options`.
- Stored rows convert: the spec and metadata-protocol pins replay `list-view-options-bag-folded` on stored rows; in ui, `ObjectView.storedRowParity-10380` and `ViewPreview.foldedOnRead-25923` render rows folded with `applyConversionsToStoredItem` and pin that an unfolded bag renders nothing.
- The test fixtures that mounted a bag (79 by the seat's count in the ruling) moved to the top-level KIND form, not loosened. Tests that pinned bag behaviour now pin that the bag is refused or reaches nothing, each beside a CONTROL with the block.

## Census

TypeScript AST + JSON + YAML walk of every object literal: views carrying a top-level `options` bag with a kind key.

| | sites | where |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `origin/main` 4b8f8cdc (19,856 files) | 158 | 157 tests + 1 the object page composer, `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` |
| this branch (21,425 files) | 109 | 106 tests that pin the refusal, the fold or the inversion + 3 in `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` (the fold's own doc and fixtures) |
| stored (examples, apps, the console's shipped metadata, ui/examples, seeds, platform-objects, fixtures) | 0 | before and after |

Not reachable, so not counted as zero: hotcrm metadata, tenant `sys_metadata` rows, cloud.

## Acceptance notes

- `chart` folds whole: the top-level `chart` block replaced the bag outright before this change, so a bag beside a block is dropped, not merged.
- Kanban title floor: after the fold the object page and the interface page still differ on a kanban card title with no `titleField`. The object page floors `titleField: 'name'` in `kanbanViewOptions` (pinned by `kanbanLane-8193`); the interface page sends none. This is pre-existing and `ObjectView.storedRowParity-10380` pins it as observed.
- The D3 entries `18.view-item-options-bag-refused.ts` and `18.view-overlay-options-bag-judged.ts` are left unedited. They describe the earlier view-item refusal and the earlier judged overlay; this PR adds `18.ui-list-view-options-bag-folded.ts` beside them.
- Overlap, rechecked at push time: #27031 and #27013 (both merged) touched `ListView.tsx`, `ListView.test.tsx` and `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`; both are in this head's main merge, which was clean, and plugin-list, types, spec and metadata-protocol were rerun after it. #26966 (open) adds its own conversion to `registry.ts`; this PR's fold is registered at order 78, so the one that lands second takes the next free order.
- Size: `dispatch-gates` counts 5,341 changed lines over 88 files (+2,704 / -2,637), over the 3,000-line human-merge threshold. Most of it is test fixtures moving from the bag to the block.
- Test-only package entries (`patch`): console, rest, metadata-protocol, lint.
- Left on #25923 after this PR (both checked on this head): work item 2 landed in #26019 except dropping `FormField`'s `[key: string]: any` index signature (`ui/packages/types/src/form.ts`), which ruling 6412606977 deferred because it breaks components `form.tsx`, plugin-form and plugin-grid; and the `immutable` follow-up from 6448239783: plugin-form's `normalizeSectionField` (`sectionFields.ts:417`) copies `immutable`, but no form renderer reads it, so an edit-mode form leaves an immutable field editable. Work item 3 is complete with #27026 and this PR.
